note: A style object declared with const inside a function and passed only to styling APIs now compiles when its entries are written out, including Emotion, styled-components and vanilla-extract aliases. Successful member, primitive and constant-condition folding accounts for erased semantic references, so mutation or extra-use paths keep the existing located refusal while safe style-only member reads compile. css() and styled() compose known conditional rule arrays with the controller read once. Whole-rule props callbacks preserve their original invocation scope, destructuring, defaults, rest and authored argument evaluation order, including covered reads and empty/static-only results; fixed dynamic values become CSS variables without a runtime rule-object interpreter. Nonzero numbers remain px lengths except for unitless properties, and proven theme paths remain static CSS variables. Implicit actual-props theme reads through own arguments or a first rest formal retain located errors with correct catch, loop, switch and var binding ownership. Named whole-rule callbacks that refer to their own binding, including metadata reads, now give a located error naming the callback and explaining that recursion is not compiled; a same-named type parameter cannot hide that value self-reference, while type-only names and actual value shadows still compile. Repeated preparation checks, traversal and error buffering are consolidated without changing output or existing diagnostics. Opaque calls in Emotion ClassNames cx remain located errors until their result is proven unable to carry Devup style classes; only that allowance is deferred. Other located errors remain: attrs chained after styles, callbacks without one immediate explicit rule object, and local style objects also read elsewhere or holding unprovable style structure. No styling runtime or helper is added.
